AAPL.rationale: Apple's fundamental health is excellent: +16.6% YoY revenue growth, +21.8% YoY EPS growth, gross margin expanding to ~49.3%, operating cash flow up +19.8% YoY, and a balance sheet that has added ~$40B in equity while reducing debt by $12B over five quarters. The franchise is durable with 90% iPhone retention, 2.2B active devices, and Services at 76% gross margins crossing $31B/quarter. However, the stock is near all-time highs ($316.22 vs $317.40 52w high) after a +22.1% quarterly rally, trading at 38x PE with an earnings yield of 2.6% that sits 194bp below the 10-year Treasury yield of 4.54%. This is in the upper half of its 365-day PE range (30.5x-43.1x). Much of the fundamental improvement appears priced in. Near-term headwinds include memory cost inflation (Tim Cook called costs 'unsustainable,' prompting device price increases and a 6.41% drop on 2026-06-26), regulatory risk on App Store commissions (worst-case 7-9% EPS impact), and an AI strategy gap versus competitors. The Q3 earnings on July 30 (consensus $1.88 EPS, +19.8% YoY) is a dated catalyst that could confirm margin resilience or disappoint, and the foldable iPhone narrative is a medium-term positive but largely a FY2027 event. The CEO succession to John Ternus in September 2026 adds governance uncertainty. Net: excellent business at a full price with modest near-term risk/reward skew.
key_factors: Q2 FY2026 revenue $111.18B, +16.6% YoY; EPS $2.01, +21.8% YoY — genuine earnings acceleration
Gross margin expanded to ~49.3% (from 47.0% YoY), operating margin ~32.3% (from ~31.0%) — real operating leverage
Operating cash flow $28.70B, +19.8% YoY; ~97% cash conversion of net income — high earnings quality
Balance sheet: equity grew from $66.76B to $106.49B (+59.5%), debt reduced from $94.80B to $82.70B, D/E at 0.777x
Services revenue >$31B/quarter at ~76% gross margin; 1B+ paid subscriptions; 90% iPhone retention rate across 2.2B active devices
PE at 37.99x (upper half of 365d range 30.5-43.1x); earnings yield 2.6% is 194bp below 10Y Treasury at 4.54%
Stock at $316.22, within $1.18 of 52w high $317.40, after +22.1% quarterly rally — much good news embedded
Memory cost inflation: Tim Cook called costs 'unsustainable' (2026-06-26), stock dropped 6.41%; Apple lobbying for CXMT access
Q3 2026 earnings July 30: consensus EPS $1.88 (+19.8% YoY), guided 14-17% revenue growth — near-term fundamental catalyst
Foldable iPhone planned at ~$2,500 with 10M unit target (2026-07-04); drove 4% stock surge, $182B market cap add
CEO succession: Cook → Ternus expected September 2026, introducing governance uncertainty
Regulatory risk: EU DMA, DOJ lawsuit, worst-case 7-9% EPS impact from App Store commission reductions
